neighbours.label: a breach that goes through a surface (puncture, tear, hole, pierce, perforation), as opposed to surface-only damage
fire: After the ride he found a slow puncture in the front wheel.
The sharp rock ripped a tear in the side of the tent.
Shrapnel pierced the fuel tank of the plane.
A small meteoroid punched a hole in the panel of the satellite.
Doctors found a perforation in the wall of the stomach.
The diver noticed a breach in the hull below the waterline.
One of the thorns punctured the inflatable boat.
The bullet went through the door and lodged in the wall.
quiet: After the ride he found a deep scratch on the front wheel.
The sharp rock left a mark on the side of the tent.
Shrapnel dented the fuel tank of the plane.
A small meteoroid left a scuff on the panel of the satellite.
Doctors found a bruise on the wall of the stomach.
The diver noticed some rust on the hull below the waterline.
One of the thorns scratched the inflatable boat.
The ball bounced off the door and rolled under the wall.
